notes.title: New Game “Whispers Among the Poppies” in Development
notes.notes:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916810/Whispers_Among_the_Poppies/"][/dynamiclink]During the full-scale invasion, a young boy flees from destruction, wandering through familiar yet ruined cities—desolate, silent, and filled with shadows. Alone, but not entirely alone. Gifted with the ability to hear the voices of those who are no longer with us, he tries to understand what happened, listening to the silent thoughts left behind in the air.[/p][p]There are no words in this story. No voices. Only footsteps, thought bubbles without text, and silence—through which the whispers of memory sometimes break through.[/p][p]You can play the demo on the game’s page
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453760/2a231c500d0c78f34fddf60d7919839aceafc616.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: My new game Shapik: The Quest is up on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Today is a big moment for me! 
My new game [b]Shapik: The Quest[/b] is up on Kickstarter!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pdbrzk/shapik-the-quest][img]https://i.imgur.com/W0Ibjcb.png[/img][/url]

Please support me on Kickstarter: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pdbrzk/shapik-the-quest]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pdbrzk/shapik-the-quest [/url]

Backers will receive a [b]Shapik: The Quest Seam Key[/b]!

[b]Shapik: The Quest – features:[/b]
[list]
[*] +10 new levels, achivement and secret objects
[*] 4K texures
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Background and characters are drawn by hand
[*] In this story you will not find a single text line. The whole story is told using animated “bubble thoughts”
[*] Our music maker composed atmospheric music to make you feel all the twists and turns and exciting moments of the plot
[/list]

The PC release date (Steam) has been set to May 2024.

[i]This game is the remaster of my first flash project released in 2011.[/i] You can check out the original game at these links: [url=https://paulp.itch.io/shapik-the-quest]Itch.io[/url], [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.questshapikapk]Google Play[/url] 

The new game is created using new technology and supports 4k textures, also added 10 new levels, new animations, puzzles, music and sound effects.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015950/Shapik_The_Quest/

notes.title: I'm refugee now, but I'm still working on my new quest
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iJ7k24p8XUw

Hello, I'm refugee from Zaporizhzhia region, Ukraine. Now I live in a village in the Vinnytsia region and am developing my second big game Shapik: The Quest(it's a prequel). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015950/

I draw a sketch in Photoshop. I want to say up front that I have never learned to draw anywhere. I realize that I have big problems with perspective, colors, and composition, but I think it's fine for the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YozRRWC.jpg[/img]

Then I color it. It turns out like this. I draw everything in separate objects to make it easier to make changes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NmbtLpT.jpg[/img]


I transfer all the drawn objects to a Spine, create bones for the animation, and lightly animate them. The result is something like this.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6YLHF8.png[/img]

Final result

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HqtKgLq.jpeg[/img]

Thank you! And I hope you enjoy my new game!
